title: Meet the Actuator Family
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics and actuator selection
description: An interactive four-column infographic comparing DC motors, relays, solenoids, and hobby servos.

learningObjectives: Explain how rotary, linear, switching, and position-controlled actuator behaviors determine suitable applications and drivers.

keyQuestions: Which actuator creates the motion a design requires?
Why do inductive loads need driver and flyback components?
commonMisconceptions: A microcontroller pin can directly power any small motor.
A relay and a solenoid perform the same external job.
